_comment_create: POST /api/agent/projects — creates a new project, or updates the existing one if external_project_id already matches a row. Header: Authorization: Bearer <AGENT_API_KEY>

body.description: Собрано из переписки инженерной группы в Telegram.

_comment_patch: PATCH /api/agent/projects/:id — :id can be either the internal project id or the external_project_id.
_comment_image: POST /api/agent/projects/:id/images — multipart/form-data, not JSON. The telegram_message_id + telegram_chat_id pair is what makes redelivery of the same Telegram message a no-op instead of a duplicate.
_comment_unassigned_image: POST /api/agent/images/unassigned — use this instead of the endpoint above when the agent is NOT confident which project the photo belongs to. It is stored for manual review (GET /api/review-queue) rather than silently guessing.

multipart_fields.reason: Could not confidently resolve which open HAVAL Jolion project this message refers to.

_comment_event: POST /api/agent/projects/:id/events — event_id must be stable per source event (e.g. the Telegram message id) so redelivery is idempotent.

payload.text: Проверили на стенде — всё в порядке, переводим в оформление.
